summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the unified 8-state tracking flow on QR reports (/requests/{id}). All acceptance criteria pass: navigation from MisSolicitudes to /requests/{id} works, request-detail-page renders with same green style as SolicitudView, tracking bar shows 8 states, admin panel updates status + records comment, history persists after reload, public tracking (/seguimiento/{token}) works without login and reflects updated status/comment, and MisSolicitudes lists both SOL and SRV rows with green status chip.
critical_code_review_comments: RequestDetail.js and SolicitudView.js share ~70% of layout (Card, TrackingBar, historial rendering). Consider extracting a shared <RequestLayout /> component to reduce duplication.
flowIndex(estado) helper is duplicated verbatim in RequestDetail.js and SolicitudView.js — move into mockData.js or a shared util.
